title: The Sky Poison Woman in the Valley
summary: At Qingshan Town, Ka Gang tells Xiao Yan that the Snake Nest Mercenary Company, led by a Six-Star Dou Ling and backed by the He family, is crushing the Bloody Battle Mercenary Company. Xiao Yan gives him Fire Lotus Vials and a jade shard to call for help, then heads into the Magical Beast Mountain Range. He takes Zi Yan and Medusa to the valley of his first seclusion, now guarded by poison and roaming Rank Four Wind Leopard Beasts. A grey-robed poison master fights Medusa, and her poison eats into Medusa's Dou Qi and sickens Zi Yan. She gives them an antidote, and Xiao Yan recognises her as Little Fairy Doctor. She flees, asking him to remember her as she was and not as the Sky Poison Woman. Xiao Yan suspects her Woeful Poison Body has taken hold, and her antidote saves Zi Yan.
